purpose: CODEX-side bridge for style/readability/render QA controls consumed by ABACUS and controlled evidence lanes.

pca_axes.name: keb_feedback_depth
pca_axes.focus: explicit KEB runtime evidence, queue status and feedback-loop closure

pca_axes.name: render_regression_depth
pca_axes.focus: replace placeholders with screenshot/html semantic diffs and Playwright output

pca_axes.name: artifact_lane_binding
pca_axes.focus: bind HTML/PDF/PPTX/Excel/graph lanes to one manifest and checksum family

pca_axes.name: style_authority
pca_axes.focus: semantic card palette and high-contrast token policy

pca_axes.name: ci_governance
pca_axes.focus: workflow grouping, slim/full tiers and release gates

dmaic.define: CODEX is the reusable style/render/CI governance bridge, not the numeric or private evidence SSOT.
dmaic.measure: Score palette, artifact lane, awake probe and penetration depth independently.
dmaic.analyze: Use reversed PCA loading order P5 to P1 to lift underdeveloped KEB/render lanes first.
dmaic.improve: Add one code-only validator before binding it into larger CI tiers.
dmaic.control: Keep the bridge manifest small, testable and binary-free.

bridge_rules: CODEX defines reusable validation meaning, not final artifact release status.
ABACUS owns user-facing artifact readiness summaries and scenario-I/O state.
cryoplant-project may emit status, hashes, counts and evidence references only.
Heavy PPTX/PDF/XLSX/HTML rendering evidence belongs in full or scheduled tiers unless the PR touches the local validator itself.

handoff_check_policy.all_clear_rule: A DMAIC/PCA/BT handoff all-clear may be recorded only when CODEX and ABACUS head and merge checks have no blocking conclusions, no unwaived cancelled checks, and no pending required checks.

repository_feedback.from_abacus: ABACUS provides user-facing artifact readiness, runtime receipt and scenario-I/O status back to CODEX bridge governance.
repository_feedback.to_abacus: CODEX provides reusable validation meaning, check-disposition taxonomy and release-manifest expectations to ABACUS.
